scripts.dev: npm run sync && npm run dev -w apps/keystone
scripts.desktop: npm run sync && cd apps/keystone && tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run sync -- --check && cd apps/keystone && tauri build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w packages/ui && npm run typecheck -w apps/keystone
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/core && npm test -w apps/keystone
scripts.check: npm run sync -- --check && npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint:taste
